final_message:
DONE

I built the Excel tracker and a short Word memo answering your three questions. I couldn't open the workbook in Excel here, so the formulas were checked by recomputing the figures in code rather than by recalculating in Excel.

1. **Departments:** Three of the five are under the 95–105% band, and none is over.

   | Department | Utilization |
   |---|---|
   | PMO | 93.2% |
   | Professional Education | 91.2% |
   | Communications | 88.1% |
   | IT | 96.1% (within band) |
   | Research | 96.1% (within band) |

2. **Individuals:** 18 of 23 are above 90% and at risk of burnout, and none is below 60%. Trevor Shaw is highest at 122%, and Zach Foster is next at 112%. Six of the seven people at or above 100% are part-time. Only George Lin, Marcus Chen, Omar Wallace, Rosa Delgado and Priya Desai are within the 60–90% range.

3. **Projects:** Six of nine went over the March budget, by 138 hours in total.

   | Project | Actual vs budget |
   |---|---|
   | Website Redesign | 279 vs 200 |
   | IT Implementation | 432 vs 375 |
   | Customer Onboarding Platform | 326 vs 300 |
   | Annual Plan | 314 vs 300 |
   | Planned Giving Campaign | 154 vs 150 |
   | Adult Outpatient Pavilion Construction | 226 vs 225 |

**Assumptions to confirm:**
- **Ellen Zhu:** She is in the timekeeping export (145 project hours) but not in the 23-person registry. I left her out of the department and individual figures. I counted her hours in the project totals, since they were charged to those projects. Without her hours, Customer Onboarding Platform falls to 282 hours and is within budget. Her registry status should be confirmed.
- **Four weeks only:** The export covers the weeks of Mar 3, 10, 17 and 24, with no Mar 31 week. Capacity is therefore 160 hours for full-time and 80 for part-time, less the 15% admin reserve.
- **Targets:** The 95–105% department target implies average staff above the 90% individual burnout line. The memo flags this, so a department can be in band and still have overloaded people.
- **Missing folders:** `workspace/` and `attachments/` weren't in the folder, so I used the three reference files as given.

The workbook has the Stakeholder Registry tab you asked for, plus summary, individual, department, project budget, timekeeping data and assumptions tabs.

Files are in `outputs/`:
- `Workload_Distribution_Tracker_March2025.xlsx`
- `Workload_Tracker_Responses.docx`
